description: Mehran Sugar Mills Limited is a public limited company founded in 1965 and quoted on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, which describes itself as a leading producer and marketer of both white and brown sugar in Pakistan. Its mill is at Deh Daro Sutha on the Tando Adam Road in Tando Allahyar, Sindh. The company also holds investments in an ethanol facility and in other listed companies, and states that its purpose is to use its molasses and bagasse to produce ethanol and power respectively.
headOffice: 14th Floor, Dolmen City Executive Tower, Marine Drive, Block 4, Clifton, Karachi 75600, Pakistan
